swelist 1.0.0 — Initial public release

- Provides a CLI tool to fetch recent technology internship and new-grad job postings using live public GitHub sources.
- Supports filtering by role (internship or newgrad) and timeframe (last day, week, or month) via CLI flags.
- Outputs plain text, agent- and human-readable job listings (company, title, location, link) to STDOUT.
- Designed for automation, agent integration, and repeated execution with predictable, stateless operation.
- No authentication, tracking, or side effects; requires Python 3.8+ and internet access.
